info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v2-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Feedback Retrieval API allows organizations to access feedback related to job applications in a streamlined manner. Users can retrieve comprehensive feedback on career applications, which can aid in improving the recruitment process and candidate experience. This API is particularly useful for HR departments and recruitment teams seeking to analyze candidate feedback efficiently. By integrating this endpoint, companies can enhance their understanding of applications and foster a more transparent recruitment environment.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch feedback related to submitted applications, providing insights into user experiences and areas for improvement.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving feedback on applications, containing relevant data encapsulated in JSON format.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on feedback applications. It is expected to be a string.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.title: Feedback Response

status.description: Indicates whether the feedback operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the feedback request.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result associated with the feedback request.

state.description: The current state of the feedback request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the feedback request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the feedback operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit information associated with the feedback operation.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.description: This schema represents the response for a feedback operation indicating the status and details of the request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier (e.g., username or ID) of the user who created the feedback.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the feedback was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the feedback creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains the audit information related to the feedback operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was instantaneous.
